monster.name: Book Mimic
monster.languages: Common, Undercommon, telepathy 120 ft.

trait.name: Published Chassis
trait.text: Use the published Juvenile Mimic as the base creature. This course version uses maximum hit points and adds the normal Mimic's Adhesive behavior.

trait.name: False Appearance
trait.text: While motionless in object form, the mimic is indistinguishable from an ordinary book.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: The mimic can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without making an ability check.

trait.name: Adhesive
trait.text: The mimic adheres to a creature that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic is grappled (escape DC 13), and ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 1d4 acid damage.

action.name: Shape-Shift
action.text: The mimic changes between its amorphous form and a Tiny book-shaped object. Its statistics do not change.

monster.name: Arcane Librarian
monster.immune: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, piercing, poison, psychic, radiant, slashing, thunder
monster.languages: Common, Draconic, Elvish, understands any written language contained in Josric's library

trait.name: Library Authorization
trait.text: The Librarian recognizes genuine written or magical authorization from Josric Pickle. Presenting valid authorization satisfies her demand automatically; no ability check is required.

trait.name: Indestructible Custodian
trait.text: The Librarian is immune to all damage. Attacks and damaging effects are still resolved normally. An attack can hit her Armor Class, but any damage dealt to her is reduced to 0.

trait.name: Constructed Purpose
trait.text: The Librarian doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Search
action.text: The Librarian takes the Search action, using Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Insight) as appropriate.

action.name: Examine Credentials
action.text: The Librarian examines one document, insignia, magical mark, or other claimed proof of authorization she can see within 5 feet. She recognizes genuine authorization from Josric automatically. A forgery or misleading document can be contested by the Librarian's Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Insight), as appropriate.

action.name: Mage Hand
action.text: The Librarian casts mage hand without material components. She normally uses it to retrieve books, accept paperwork, return misplaced objects, or point toward something a visitor should stop touching.

action.name: Prestidigitation
action.text: The Librarian casts prestidigitation without material components. She normally uses it to clean surfaces, extinguish unattended flames, mark misplaced books, or produce small signs of disapproval.

action.name: Utilize
action.text: The Librarian takes the Utilize action to operate a library mechanism, open or close an authorized door, retrieve a record, or manipulate another appropriate object.

action.name: Bonus Action — Return to Shelf
action.text: One unattended book or similar Tiny object the Librarian can see within 30 feet magically moves up to 20 feet toward its proper location. This ability can't move an object being worn or carried by an unwilling creature.

reaction.name: Protect the Collection
reaction.text: When a creature the Librarian can see within 30 feet makes an attack against a book, shelf, desk, manuscript, or other library property, the Librarian grants that object a +5 bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

reaction.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
reaction.text: Josric uses the published Mage's Protective Magic to produce shield or counterspell, as appropriate to the trigger.
